item.title: NestJS 12: ESM Packages, Standard Schema Validation and Native Observability
item.description: NestJS version 12 has been released, transitioning core packages to ESM and adding Standard Schema validation. It updates the CLI and introduces an observability SDK. (1 source: infoq)

item.title: Beginning of the Ende (a community Deno fork)
item.description: The trend of VC-backed tooling ending in abandonment rears its ugly head again. But hey, people gotta eat, right? The community will pick up the slack and steward the projects, right? (1 source: lobsters)
